value.rationale: The full order-four de Bruijn family is a natural, finite pseudorandom sequence codebook. Word-space Fourier convolution rank measures exact recoverability beyond local orthogonality. The sharp unrestricted endpoint projection constant 157517/4096 measures optimally stable recovery and is not determined by the known codeword count or simple two-bit autocorrelations. The nonlocal lag law and 9254 additional even-weight cancellations give interpretable structure and a reproducible benchmark.
